brief: Modern Indian luxury fashion house pairing heritage handloom textiles (Banarasi silk, Chanderi, Mulmul) with contemporary architectural tailoring.

concepts.name: The Sovereign Identity
concepts.idea: An architectural Roman Didone wordmark with diamond-shard accent paired with the Sovereign L insignia.
rationale: Custom-sculpted Roman Didone capitals with wide 35% luxury letter-spacing.
The signature 45° diamond-shard grave accent on È celebrates the soul of Lumière (Light).
The Sovereign L monogram is engineered for 3D cast metallic bag hardware, gold-foil stamping, and micro-scale app icons.

recommendation: Approved direction: The Sovereign Identity (Bespoke Didone Wordmark + Sovereign L Monogram).
